# 打印错误码 / Print error codes · 18

[返回索引 / Index](../../PRINT-ERROR-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `0x18004025` | AMS-HT A 耗材信息读取失败 | Failed to read AMS-HT A filament information. |
| `0x18008003` | 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能堵头或耗材卡在挤出机内部。 | Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. This might be caused by clogged extruder or filament broken inside the extruder. |
| `0x18008004` | 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败。可能是因为料盘卡住，或者耗材的端头卡在路径中。 | AMS-HT failed to pull back filament. This could be due to a stuck spool or the end of the filament being stuck in the path. |
| `0x18008005` | 耗材送出AMS-HT失败。请取出耗材后，剪平料头重新插入。如果异常继续，请检查AMS内部特氟龙管有无磨损。 | The AMS-HT failed to send out filament. You can clip the end of your filament flat, and reinsert. If this message persists, please check the PTFE tubes in AMS for any signs of wear and tear. |
| `0x18008006` | 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及AMS特氟龙管未接上。 | Unable to feed filament into the extruder. This could be due to an entangled filament or a stuck spool. If not, please check if the AMS-HT PTFE tube is connected. |
| `0x18008007` | 耗材挤出失败，请检查挤出机是否堵塞。 | Extruding filament failed. The extruder might be clogged. |
| `0x1800800A` | 检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查从AMS-HT A到挤出机的特氟龙管是否接好。 | PTFE tube disconnection detected. Please check if the PTFE tube from AMS-HT A to the extruder is properly connected. |
| `0x18008010` | AMS-HT助力电机过载，可能是因为耗材缠住或料盘卡住。 | The AMS-HT assist motor is overloaded. This could be due to entangled filament or a stuck spool. |
| `0x18008011` | AMS-HT 耗材已用尽，请将新耗材放入原 AMS-HT 槽位后继续操作。 | AMS-HT filament has run out. Please load new filament into the original AMS-HT slot to continue. |
| `0x18008012` | 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击"继续"重试。 | Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry. |

| `0x18008016` | 检测到挤出机无法挤出耗材，请查看助手排除故障。可能在这层出现打印缺陷，如果接受请继续打印。 | The extruder is not extruding normally; please refer to the Assistant. After trouble shooting. If the defects are acceptable, please resume. |
| `0x18008017` | AMS-HT A 在烘干中，无法发起进退料，请停止烘干后重新发起。 | AMS-HT A is drying. Please stop drying process before loading/unloading material. |

| `0x18008036` | 热端挂架粗回中失败，请检查是否有异物阻挡或打印板放置不正确。 | Hotend rack coarse homing failed. Please check for obstructions or if the build plate is misaligned. |
